question: A ‘gnomon’ is a part of a ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**sundial.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The gnomon is the part of a sundial that casts the shadow.**
 
• It is probably also the** world's oldest astronomical instrument.**
 
• It is like a** pole stuck in the sand.**
 
• It has been** used to measure the passage of time by nomadic cultures of the Sahara for centuries.**
 
• The gnomon may be **a rod, wire, or elaborately decorated metal casting.**
 
• **It has to be parallel to the axis of the Earth's rotation for the sundial** to be accurate throughout the year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be090feb9d86526d2c77c6eb51288cb98c10add90c730b87bf6a7fb8fef3da2a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Telescope**

 
 
• **​Used to form magnified images of distant objects.**
 
• **Most important investigative instrument in astronomy.**
 
• **Galileo **applied the **telescope to the study of extraterrestrial bodies.**
 
 
 
• **Transformer **
 
 
• An **electrical device designed to convert alternating current from one voltage to another.**
 
• It can be** designed to "step up" or "step down" voltages.**
 
• Works on the** magnetic induction principle.**
 
 
 
• **Bolometer**
 
 
• ​The bolometer is a device **used for detecting and measuring the heat and radiation of Microwave energy or RF.**
 
• It **uses the temperature-sensitive resistive element** whose resistance changes with the temperature.
 
• The** Thermistor and Barretter are examples** of the commonly used resistive element.
